items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under clauses 2.1 and 3.1.4. Clauses 4.3(d)–(f) also exclude personal belongings carried in a vehicle away from the insured location, so no amount is payable.
Clause 4.3(e) excludes the car, and clause 5.2.5 excludes vehicle and journey expenses. No insured building damage occurred, so no amount is payable.
